script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Sudarshan Solar Systems se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — aapka account kaafi purana hai, almost 10 saal se zyada, lekin is mahine humne dekha ki aap sirf 3 din hi platform pe active rahe — toh sochा ek baar directly baat karein.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kya koi specific wajah hai jiske chalte login kam ho gaya hai? Matlab kya leads quality theek nahi lag rahi, ya business mein koi aur cheez busy rakh rahi hai, ya platform use karna thoda complicated lag raha hai?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karna chahta hoon — aapki Buy Lead activity is mahine 80% girr gayi hai month-on-month, aur PNS calls mein bhi sirf 43% success rate hai, matlab 10 mein se 6 calls miss ho rahi hain. Solar category mein demand abhi bhi aa rahi hai platform pe, toh yeh leads kisi aur seller ke paas ja rahi hain jo active hai.
script_parts.action: Abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka PNS setting check karta hoon aur agar call timing ya number update karna ho toh woh 2 minute mein fix kar dete hain, aur ek saath aapka catalog bhi dekh lete hain ki koi product listing outdated toh nahi hai jiske wajah se leads drop ho rahi hain.
script_parts.close: Bhai ji, aaj ke liye bas itna — PNS fix ho gaya aur catalog refresh ho gaya. Agle 15 din mein agar aap week mein 3-4 baar bhi login karein aur Buy Leads pe respond karein, toh hum saath mein track karenge ki kuch improvement aata hai ya nahi. Koi bada commitment nahi — bas ek baar try karte hain?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with someone from Sudarshan Solar Systems? This is IndiaMART calling — your account is over 10 years old with us, but this month we noticed you were active on the platform for only 3 days, so I wanted to connect directly and understand what's going on.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — is there a specific reason your logins have dropped so much? Is it that the lead quality doesn't feel right, or is something else keeping you busy, or does the platform feel a bit complicated to use these days?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's something important I want to share — your Buy Lead activity has dropped 80% month-on-month, and your PNS call success rate is only 43%, meaning 6 out of every 10 calls are being missed. Solar is still a category with incoming demand on the platform, which means those leads are going to other active sellers instead of you.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll check your PNS settings and if the call timing or number needs updating, we can fix that in 2 minutes, and we'll also quickly review your catalog together to see if any product listings are outdated and causing lead drop-off.
script_parts_en.close: For today, that's all — PNS is fixed and catalog is refreshed. Over the next 15 days, if you can log in 3-4 times a week and respond to Buy Leads, we'll track together whether things improve. No big commitment — let's just give it one honest try?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
